SCE.S:2BC854: My school friend. Does "space-time" research on his father's money. The government watches it.
SCE.S:2BCDE8: Worked 43 years here until the warehouse closed. Bedridden for 10 years, the "anomaly" healed him; he came back.
SCE.S:2BD778: Third agent sent to look into the City. Trailing his predecessor to the hospital, he was "treated" and sent here.
SCE.S:2BD844: Tax man Sugimura came to audit the warehouse, fused with old machinery, and wrote a new page in life's history.
SCE.S:2DC384: {5}There's a strange device. Why would something like this be left in a deserted warehouse?
SCE.S:2DE58C: {5}The door won't open.... I can't get outside.
SCE.S:2E0C80: {6}Get out of here! Stop wrecking the warehouse! Everything here is mine!
SCE.S:2E0D28: {6}I WILL REMOVE YOU, BASED ON MY OWN "FREE WILL"!
SCE.S:2E12D8: This is bad. A door closing by itself in an empty warehouse? The devices on both sides are some kind of sensors. They went off. This place has been taken over too, probably.
SCE.S:2E13BC: The devices on both sides are some kind of sensors. They went off. Let's be careful.
SCE.S:2E1458: Another door. Something's going to come out. But... they can't have set this up knowing we'd come. What could be hidden in such an old warehouse?
SCE.S:2E1544: These sensors look like the cover of an old sci-fi magazine. For security, a small infrared one would do. They must be sensing something else, like an intruder's thoughts.
SCE.S:2E1634: This is just my guess, but... I think these sensors probe an intruder's mind and only react to "humans" who've noticed the "city's anomaly." Normally it looks like a plain closed-up warehouse, and they deal efficiently only with dangerous intruders. The "enemy" doesn't want to stir things up more than necessary.
SCE.S:2E179C: Judging by the response, the "enemy" inside doesn't seem to have enough power yet. The number of guard robots is probably limited, too.
SCE.S:2E186C: This warehouse hasn't been used in ten years. The company seems to have gone bankrupt. Let's go further in. There might be something.
SCE.S:2E19B4: The door still doesn't seem to open.
SCE.S:2E1A2C: This warehouse has other entrances. Let's go outside and try another way around.
SCE.S:2E1ACC: The warehouse is split across the water into an east building and a west building. If I remember right, each has three entrances. I've been here several times, so I remember. It's a handy place for my experiments.
SCE.S:2E1BD8: I've been confused for a while now. I can't tell if I'm in the west building or the east.
SCE.S:2E1C7C: The door opened. Let's go outside.
SCE.S:2E23BC: This must be a terminal for the security system. Destroying the guard robot canceled number 1. But we still can't go any further in.
SCE.S:2E248C: Now number 2 is canceled. Do we have to cancel all of them up to number 5 before we can go further?
SCE.S:2E2538: The security terminals are all linked. How does that work? Anyway, let's look for number 4.
SCE.S:2E25F0: Next is the last one, number 5. The security system spans the west and east buildings. Why didn't they set up a separate system for each?
SCE.S:2E26CC: Something connected with a click beyond the door at the back. We should be able to go further in now.
SCE.S:2E2770: It looks like we still need an {8}ID card. I hope we can get one at the other entrance we haven't been in yet...
SCE.S:2E5CF8: {6}Is something wrong? This warehouse is managed by our company. Oh, wait a moment. You two are the ones from the power plant, aren't you? You've caused us trouble.
SCE.S:2E5EE4: {1}An {8}ID card{1} is lying on the desk.
SCE.S:2E6164: This device... Like the one under the power plant... advanced theory and shoddy makeshift technology live side by side. It looks like the mind of an alien who knows the true nature of the universe built it using a primitive Earthling's body. In that imbalance may lie the essence of the "enemy's" true nature.
SCE.S:2E6448: That robot looked just like the Martian vehicles in novels. It seemed built for combat.
SCE.S:2E6650: {6}This planet is one weird laboratory. What I'm testing is getting organic and inorganic bodies to coexist. Carbon-based bodies are fragile, after all. Great as vessels for keeping my "essence," right? The look is a bit ugly, but these are the only parts I had on hand. I'll tune it up more soon. Want to merge with me?
SCE.S:2E696C: {6}I'm with a government investigation agency. Nothing unusual is happening in this town. ...No. You two seem to already know too much.
SCE.S:2E6A80: {6}I'm with a government investigation agency. You met my colleague. Please tell him: the one is in the back room. I confirmed that he was changing. They were all ordinary people once. I saw them fuse with machines. The robots you saw were built to cut off the town's transport network. But it's all right now. I tampered with the control unit. The robots shouldn't move anymore. This is as far as I can go. Report everything to my successor at the {7}hotel{6}! I'm sorry, but I'm already done for. Kill me before I start to deform.
SCE.S:2E9AF0: {6}Why did you come to a place like this?
SCE.S:2E9CCC: {5}A broken alarm device is still here. The door to the back seems to be sealed.
SCE.S:2EC2DC: {5}A broken alarm device is still here. The door to the back seems to be sealed.
SCE.S:2EF284: {6}Hello. It seems an "ego" is finally sprouting in me, too.
SCE.S:2EF440: {6}Even after everything "changed," I end up coming back here. I worked here every day for over forty years.
SCE.S:2EF51C: {6}If you have time, go in through another entrance.
SCE.S:2EF634: {6}There's word that the "army" will move to take control of this town soon.
SCE.S:2EF6DC: {6}I have achieved an evolution no one has reached before!
SCE.S:2EFA9C: {6}Can you hear my "voice"? I guard this entrance. I resonate with the values and emotions of all intelligent life. And I keep out anything that would harm the plan.
SCE.S:2EFBA8: {6}What you are looking at is my core. Five of my comrades are here. We cooperate to guard the center of this building. The five of us run bypasses through the surrounding space and connect every entrance to a single center.
SCE.S:2EFD54: {6}Here we assemble three-legged "artificial life." For something built with Earth technology, it's turned out decently. As a trial, we have deployed "artificial life" on the expressways around town.
SCE.S:2EFF80: {6}We were given the ability to "see" the structure of space-time and the waves of life. With these new senses, we apply the technology stored in our brains to build these "machines."
SCE.S:2F0144: {6}Getting used to it yet? What "strategy" will you evolve with? Send me your information. What I'm testing is getting organic and inorganic bodies to coexist. Carbon-based bodies are fragile. Great as vessels for keeping my "essence," right?
SCE.S:2F0384: {6}I was dispatched by the "government" that governs this planet. Let's advance the "plan" quickly. The "government" is starting to pay attention to this town.
SCE.S:2F04D4: {6}This is the "artificial life" assembled to manage the town. The outside is covered with inorganic parts, but inside is a silicon-based life form.
